chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about who the sacrificed one was, so he said:
"Isma'il عليه السلام, because Allah, Mighty and Majestic, mentioned his story in His Book, then said:
"And We gave him glad tidings of Ishaq, a prophet from among the righteous."

key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلُ: Isma'il عليه السلام, identified here as the sacrificed son
key_terms.قِصَّتَهُ: his account or story as mentioned in the Qur'an
key_terms.وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ: And We gave him glad tidings

ai.seo_question: According to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام, who was the dhabih, Isma'il or Ishaq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام identifies the sacrificed son as Isma'il عليه السلام. He supports this by pointing to the Qur'anic sequence in which the account is mentioned and then the glad tidings of Ishaq عليه السلام are given afterward, indicating that the intended sacrificed one was not Ishaq.
